name: P1 pond (recommended) · ~0.23 ML
notes: 3 m wall about 24 m long holds about 0.2 ML (233 m³) over 200 m². Wall earthworks roughly 535 m³. 4.0 ha drains to it. Small catchment: the easiest kind of in-gully pond; still needs a spillway. About 222 m above the house: a gravity source, but fit a pressure-reducing valve. Computed from 5 m elevation, so check on site.
